_comment: Cards that exist only for the static cast-lock test (tests/unit/test_static_zone_cast_lock.py). Never part of a deck list. `t_hand_only_magistrate` is Drannith Magistrate's line on a vanilla body. `t_graveyard_warden` writes the positive `zones` spelling, shutting graveyards alone. `t_hand_only_curfew` is the same lock with an 'as long as' condition (during your turn), so the condition is shown to be honoured rather than dropped. The cast lines are measured with the cards from tests/data/cant_cast_spells_from_zones.cards.json (`t_ember_recall`, `t_ashen_warden`), tests/data/library_top_cast.cards.json (`t_citadel`) and tests/data/testing.cards.json (`t_cascader`, `t_foreteller`, `t_bear`).
